description: An API-first BGP daemon in Rust for programmable route-server and control-plane use cases

summary.one_liner: rustbgpd is an API-first BGP daemon written in Rust for route servers, route reflectors, and network automation, controlled through gRPC or the rbgp CLI.
summary.what_it_does: The daemon manages BGP peers, applies policy, and injects routes through a gRPC API or the rbgp command-line tool. It lets you inspect unicast route decisions from the live RIB and explain export decisions, including a per-prefix explain command. Policies are written in .rpol files with named prefix and community sets, composition, and unit tests; they can be compiled offline and dry-run against a running daemon's RIB before being applied. It can stream routing events via BMP and MRT feeds, and it supports FlowSpec origination and reconciliation under a scoped controller contract. The README also describes RPKI, Add-Path, and route-reflector reflection for IPv4/IPv6 unicast, with VPN, labeled-unicast, and scoped EVPN Types 1–5 reflection under separate support limits.
use_cases: run an IXP route server with per-member policy
inject and withdraw routes via API
monitor BGP sessions with BMP or MRT feeds
test routing policy before applying it
originate FlowSpec rules for DDoS mitigation
how_to_run: docker compose exec rustbgpd rbgp -s summary
docker compose exec rustbgpd rbgp -s top
notable: Policy language (.rpol) with offline compile, unit tests, and live dry-run against the RIB
Per-route explain for RIB and export decisions via rbgp
Narrow v1 compatibility contract for route-server, route-reflector, and scoped FlowSpec surfaces (baseline v0.80.1)
Default gRPC listener is a local Unix socket; remote admin uses mTLS and authorization
Docker Compose demo with FRR peer and TUI
caveats: Project is alpha overall; features outside the listed v1 surfaces carry no compatibility promise
Supports Linux x86_64 and aarch64 only; Linux FIB integration is opt-in
Does not provide VPN PE/VRF or MPLS forwarding, nor a full multi-protocol routing suite
